'''Danzigorro Potts''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] serving the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] at the time of the [[First Great Schism]].

==Biography==
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]], Danzigorro Potts was [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] on their fortress world of [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]] circa [[24,500 BBY]]. Taken as the [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Jook-jook H'broozin]], Potts was close friends with fellow apprentice [[Blendri]], who described him as simple while she was bored with [[Meditation/Legends|meditation]] and the strictures of the Order. When Blendri ascended to the rank of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]], Potts remained a Padawan and struggled to keep up with the training, despite his dedication to the Order.<ref name="JVS" />

When the Jedi named [[Xendor]] rebelled against the Order and formed the [[Legions of Lettow]], Blendri deserted, leaving Ossus with Master H'broozin and a new apprentice to join Xendor's forces. Not tempted by the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] and comfortable in the Order's structure, Potts joined the fight to destroy the rebels and end the [[First Great Schism]] before it destroyed the Order. Having slain his former master on [[Corulag/Legends|Corulag]], Potts was later stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Columus/Legends|Columus]] where he and a group of Jedi were [[Battle of Columus|pitted]] against a group of thirty members of the Legion. Almost evenly matched, Potts fought long and hard, coming up against Blendri and her apprentice before killing them both. The lone survivor and gravely wounded, Potts received word that Xendor had been slain and the war was over. Pleased with Xendor's death, Potts recorded his final thoughts on a [[Columus Data Card|data card]], recording what had happened and his thoughts on [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] and the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], leaving it to whatever Jedi would find it. Among his thoughts was the need for the Jedi Order to have a common enemy, to keep themselves from turning against each other. The data card was found incomplete and was later the basis for three separate operas.<ref name="JVS" />
